data.name: Aegis of Shadows
data.description: Creates a shadow barrier that absorbs attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a series of intricate hand seals, and the shadows around them coil and rise like a sentient tide. The darkness hardens, forming an impenetrable barrier around %user or their allies. Incoming attacks dissipate harmlessly against the wall of shadow, as if swallowed by an abyss. The eerie veil flickers, warding off all but the most relentless assaults.

data.name: Blazing Fang Strike
data.description: Unleashes fiery dragon fangs to pierce enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user performs swift hand seals, summoning the fiery essence of a dragon. Twin fangs of flame erupt from their palms, spiraling with intense heat. With a ferocious roar, the fiery fangs lunge toward %target, searing through defenses and engulfing the enemy in a blaze of dragon-shaped fury. The battlefield glows with residual embers, a testament to the power unleashed.

data.name: Celestial Dew
data.description: Summons celestial dew to heal allies' wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands, invoking a soft, luminous chant. From above, ethereal droplets of dew descend, shimmering with celestial light. The dew gathers upon %user and their allies, mending wounds and revitalizing spirits. As the healing touch takes effect, a sense of tranquility washes over the battlefield, bolstering resilience against further harm.

data.name: Subaku Palace
data.description: Stolen from the Subaku Castle, This forbidden Jutsu grants the users the powers to call forth the demon palace to increase their offense and defense
data.battleDescription: %user presses their hand to the ground, a chakra formula spreads from their hands to the corners of the battlefield, large demon gates appears out of the earth surrounding %target

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description:
A slicing whirlwind cuts through multiple foes!

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user spins swiftly, their weapon or bare hands channeling gale-force winds. The air around them ignites into a slicing vortex, ripping through the battlefield. %target and surrounding enemies are caught in the tempest, battered by razor-sharp wind currents. The relentless storm fades with a final powerful slash, leaving devastation in its wake.

data.name: Dark World
data.description: A Forbidden Jutsu that releases the shadows of the underworld on target.
data.battleDescription: %user forces chakra through their body, causing it to pour into their body. The chakra mixes with their shadow, which grows and absorbs every bit of shadow in the vicinity. As the shadow spreads around %target it also expands, covering the surrounding area in complete darkness. The moment the jutsu hits completely locks %target in a dome of darkness, black razor spikes rapidly jut and retract out of the ground around stabbing %target

data.name: Dragon King's Impact
data.description: A Forbidden jutsu that uses the users own lifeforce to generate a high flying attack
data.battleDescription: %user uses a single hand to perform a series of simple hand seals before pressing the same hand on their blade. The blade shimmers briefly as %user jumps into the air, the chakra flowing around the weapon forms a dragon-shape around %user, the maw centered around the tip. With breathtaking speed, %user plummets towards %target, smashing the %weapon at them with devastating power, destroying everything at the impact zone.

data.name: Fury of The White Tiger
data.description: Open seven of the eight inner gates to release a devastating strike at the target
data.battleDescription: Waves of green and blue energy flow from %user `s body as %user opens the first seven Inner Gates. Each Gate increases their  strength and speed significantly, engulfing %user with an all repelling aura of pure power. %user goes into the Tiger stance before striking the air in front of them with  an explosion of power. The violent punch sends a massive tiger-shaped shockwave at %target.

data.name: Gaze into Yomi
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that brings your opponent's loved ones to the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user forms hand seals while smoke rises from their body. The smoke rapidly expands into a cloud, engulfing %user and hiding them from sight. %target feels a cold chill run down their back as the area around them turns grey and all color drains from their vision. The smoke materializes into spirit-like apparitions resembling deceased family members. They float around %target, softly wailing in agony as they close in.

data.name: Adamantine Fortress
data.description: A defensive earth-style jutsu that raises barriers to protect the user and reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions. Thick stone walls erupt around them in a rapid formation—dense, layered, and reinforced with chakra. These barriers deflect incoming strikes and dull the force of enemy attacks. While active, the user’s body is further reinforced by lingering stone chakra, allowing them to absorb more punishment than usual

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that enhances all offensive abilities and raises the user’s stats.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in waves—thick, radiant, and barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. Simultaneously, the user’s core stats spike, fueling their body and mind for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It’s the edge between control and chaos—a moment where the user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Crescent  Reaper Fang
data.description: A high-speed weapon slash that deals massive damage and causes the enemy to suffer and blocking all attempts at curing the damage.
data.battleDescription: %user grips their weapon with both hands and crouches low before vanishing in a flash of speed. A single arc slices through the air past %target, and for a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then—a diagonal wound bursts open across their body, blood spraying as if the strike had been delayed in time. But the real sting comes after: %target’s movements become unstable, and every attack they throw reverberates with backlash, as if their body is punishing them for moving too soon

data.name: Eclipse Drain
data.description:
A cursed enhancement that boosts the user’s damage and restores health with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body—restoring vitality through every blow.

data.name: Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance
data.description: An elite taijutsu barrage that deals massive damage and briefly prevents the target from receiving buffs.
data.battleDescription: %user’s stance drops low—tense, almost still—then detonates. With masterful precision and tempestuous speed, they unleash Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance: eight rapid, deliberate strikes in perfect rhythm. Each blow strikes with surgical accuracy, shattering %target’s guard and driving them backward, balance crumbling under the relentless cadence.

data.name: Leviathan's Embrace
data.description: A devastating water-taijutsu strike that siphons vitality from the enemy, feeding the user with every impact.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the wrath of the deep as water chakra surges down their spine and coils around their limbs like serpents from the abyss. With a chilling calm, they close in on %target and drive their fist forward—unleashing a crushing blow that echoes with the pressure of the ocean floor. The strike erupts in a spiral of black-blue water, tearing through defenses and drawing life essence back into %user like a drowning tide claiming its own. Each hit binds them deeper to the flow of the enemy’s chakra—feeding strength to their body as they press on like the relentless sea.

data.name: Sealing Technique: Lotus Barrier
data.description: Create a barrier made of Chakra that takes shape in a Lotus form to block all summoning's
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, releasing a bloom of glowing lotus-shaped seals that spread outward in a perfect circle. The lotus petals rise upward, forming a radiant, semi-transparent barrier of light around %target

data.name: Aqua Fist
data.description: Forms water around the fists for devastating punches.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists, surrounded by swirling, hardened water, unleash a barrage of punches at %target, each strike hitting with the force of crashing waves, disrupting their chakra flow and leaving them vulnerable.

data.name: Blazing Flash
data.description: Envelops the user in flames to move with explosive speed.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, igniting flames that swirl around their body. With a sudden burst of energy, they propel themselves forward at blinding speed, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. The intense heat generated by their movement scorches the ground and air, making it difficult for the opponent to follow their path. As %user moves, the flames around them roar and grow, turning their rapid dashes into fiery streaks that sear anything they touch. The final strike comes when %user reappears behind the opponent, the flames concentrating into a devastating kick or punch, sending a wave of fire through the opponent's body, engulfing them in a burst of flames. The battlefield is left smoldering, with %user standing amidst the remnants of their fiery dash.

data.name: Burning Coil
data.description: A fiery bind that burn the target
data.battleDescription: %user summons blazing coils of fire that wrap around %target, searing their skin causing them to take more damage.

data.name: Earthquake Slam
data.description: The user channels earth chakra to deliver a powerful Earthquake Slam, causing the ground to shake upon impact and momentarily staggering nearby enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user's decisive slam sends shockwaves through the ground, briefly damaging, staggering and disrupting the balance of %target and nearby foes.

data.name: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp
data.description: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp is a Taijutsu technique that focuses on immobilizing the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra into their fists, delivering a barrage of strikes that causes the ground to erupt. Earthen hands emerge, immobilizing %target's legs. %user finishes with a crushing kick, sending %target to the ground, leaving them unable to move.

data.name: Fire Fist
data.description: Ignite your fist and strike with a burst of fire that scorches nearby enemies.
data.battleDescription: With a focused burst of chakra, %user ignites their fist in roaring flames. The strike releases a fiery shockwave that scorches %target.

data.name: First Chakra Gate
data.description: unlocks the user's chakra flow, enhancing their Ninjutsu abilities.
data.battleDescription: A deep roar echoes from within as %user tears open the first chakra gate. Their aura erupts in a violent surge of energy, rippling through the air like a heatwave. Veins glow beneath their skin as raw chakra floods their network, amplifying every movement and sharpening their control. The ground beneath them fractures under the pressure, and the battlefield trembles as their ninjutsu flares with newfound ferocity faster, heavier, and more destructive than before.

data.name: Flame Infusion
data.description: A burning taijutsu attack that damages the enemy and weakens their stats
data.battleDescription: %user drives a flame-laced strike into %target, searing flesh and spirit alike, leaving their strength smoldering in ruin.

data.name: Harden Fist
data.description: A taijutsu technique that hardens the user’s body to boost strength, speed, and striking power.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, chakra flowing into their limbs until the muscle fibers tense like steel cables. A faint aura pulses around their fists—dense, controlled, and brimming with suppressed force. Harden Fist enhances the body at its core, boosting raw Strength and Speed while reinforcing every strike with hardened impact. The result is a sharper, faster, more brutal form of taijutsu—each blow landing with enhanced precision and punishing force. It’s not just about hitting harder—it’s about becoming a weapon in motio

data.name: Hurricane Strike
data.description: A swift, spinning kick enhanced by wind chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their leg, executing a spinning kick that generates a powerful gust, striking %target with force and sending them reeling backward.

data.name: Ice Vortex
data.description: Creates a powerful polar vortex to cover enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a raging vortex of water, engulfing %target in relentless, churning currents.

data.name: Inferno Cyclone
data.description: Creates a rotating column of fire.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a blazing cyclone, engulfing %target in flames that sap their strength and resolve.

data.name: Inner Flame
data.description: A fiery aura that amplifies power and shields the user. Through unknown methods, it seems to be able to convert damage into chakra and stamina for the user.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their inner fire, reducing the force of incoming blows and using the energy to replenish and reinforce themselves.

data.name: Lightning Blitz Strike
data.description: Channel lightning chakra into your limbs to deliver a swift series of electrifying taijutsu strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user charges their limbs with crackling lightning and delivers a rapid series of electrifying blows to %target.

data.name: Lightning Drift
data.description: Drift like lightning through the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into the air, infusing it with the raw energy of lightning. With a sudden surge, they vanish in a streak of light, their body becoming as fluid and unpredictable as a lightning bolt. Weaving through obstacles and enemies alike, %user appears and disappears in rapid succession, their movements too fast to be tracked by the naked eye. As they drift through the battlefield, crackling electricity trails behind them, leaving the opponent disoriented and vulnerable. The air around %user hums with static, making it clear that the storm is far from over.

data.name: Lightning Flash Step
data.description: A rapid movement technique that leaves behind a trail of electricity.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with lightning chakra, moving at blinding speeds to disorient %target and deliver rapid, precise strikes from all angles.

data.name: Lightning Release: Raijin's Bow
data.description: Raijin's Bow is a powerful lightning-based jutsu that manifests as a bow made of crackling electricity. It allows the user to create and shoot arrows infused with lightning, dealing devastating damage to their target.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, intricate hand seal, %user channels their lightning chakra, shaping it into a dazzling bow crackling with raw energy. Nocking an arrow of pure electricity, they draw and release, sending the charged projectile streaking towards %target. The arrow explodes on impact in a blinding flash and deafening thunderclap, unleashing a torrent of lightning that engulfs %target in a devastating storm of electricity.

data.name: Lightning Release: Spark Blade
data.description: The user channels lightning chakra into their blade, causing it to crackle with electricity upon contact, delivering a shocking jolt to the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into their blade, causing it to crackle with electrifying energy. With a swift and precise strike, %user slashes through the air, releasing a dazzling display of sparks. Upon contact, the blade delivers a shocking jolt to %target, leaving them vulnerable to further Bukijutsu attacks.

data.name: Lightning Release: Thunder Edge
data.description: Lightning Release: Thunder Edge is a versatile jutsu that allows the user to infuse their weapon with lightning chakra, increasing its cutting power and range. When the weapon makes contact with a target, it releases a surge of electrical energy.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of electrical chakra through their blade and strikes the ground. With this blade, the electrical current surges throughout the battlefield wrapping itself around %target.

data.name: Lightning Ward
data.description: Envelops your weapon in lightning, strengthening your Lightning Bukijutsu and leaving the target vulnerable to further weapon attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their weapon with crackling lightning, empowering their Lightning Bukijutsu before marking %target with electricity that leaves them vulnerable to further weapon attacks.

data.name: Medusa's Gaze
data.description: A mythical Genjutsu that powers up the user's abilities by channeling the power of Medusa.
data.battleDescription: %user locks their eyes and begins channeling their Chakra. After a brief moment, the opponent opens their eyes. Revealing a powerful yellow gaze that amplifiesthe opponent 's genjutsu powers by channeling Medusa's power into them.

data.name: Phantom Step
data.description: Move with ghostly silence and speed.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into their legs and feet, synchronizing their movements with the surrounding shadows. With a light step, they become nearly invisible to the naked eye, their presence fading like a phantom. The user moves silently and swiftly, weaving through obstacles and enemies without making a sound. As %user advances, their form flickers in and out of visibility, confusing the opponent and making it difficult to track their movements. By the time the opponent realizes %user's position, it's already too late; %user has either evaded the attack or positioned themselves for a counterstrike.

data.name: Primate Assimilate
data.description: Gain the ability to briefly absorb damage.

effects.description: Absorb damage taken & convert to health, chakra or stamina

data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, performing the Primate Assimilate jutsu. Through this technique, their simian ally gains the power to absorb the abilities or attacks of their opponents, enhancing their combat prowess. The bond between %user and their monkey comrade grows stronger as they share this unique ability.

data.name: Quaking Earth Strike
data.description: Causes the ground to quake and shatter under enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user smashes the earth, sending shockwaves into %target, weakening their defenses against further attacks.

data.name: Rock Barrage
data.description: Launches multiple rock projectiles at the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, channeling chakra to tear the earth apart beneath them. With a precise swing, they command jagged chunks of stone to rise and fly forward like deadly missiles. The barrage of sharpened rocks strikes the battlefield in a brutal, calculated rhythm, dealing heavy earth-based damage.

data.name: Siren's Lament
data.description: The user creates a powerful genjutsu that lures the target into a false reality where they are surrounded by a tranquil ocean.
data.battleDescription: The battlefield is engulfed in a haunting melody as %user's hands dance in graceful, intricate patterns, casting Siren's Lament. %target's eyes widen, captivated by an illusion of a beautiful, yet treacherous, underwater world. Enchanted, they begin to sink into the illusionary depths, their movements sluggish and their breath hitching. Images of ethereal creatures glide by, their eerie calls echoing in %target's mind, luring them further into the depths. As %user completes the jutsu, %target is left gasping for air, shaken by the vividness of the illusion.

data.name: Stormcaller's Wrath
data.description: Summons a lightning storm to strike foes.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging storm that crashes down upon %target, dealing heavy damage. The relentless surge tears through defenses, leaving %target’s guard shattered and their resistance lowered.

data.name: Tempest Dash
data.description: A powerful wind-propelled dash.
data.battleDescription: In the heat of battle, %user focuses their chakra, allowing it to flow into their legs. With a sudden surge of energy, the air around them whirls and intensifies. In an instant, %user propels themselves forward with the force of a tempest, moving at a speed that seems almost impossible. The wind roars in their wake, creating a vortex that disturbs the surroundings and momentarily disorients any nearby foes. As %user completes their dash, they reappear in a new position, ready to strike or evade further assaults, while the chaotic winds they leave behind continue to buffet the opponent.

data.name: Tempest of the Blade
data.description: The user creates a large, blade-shaped construct of pure wind chakra, which can be wielded as a weapon or launched at the target with tremendous force.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, the air around them becomes charged with energy, swirling into a tempest. With a mighty swing, %user unleashes this tempest upon %target, the blade cutting through the air with a deafening roar. The tempest strikes %target with the force of a raging storm, dealing devastating damage.

data.name: Tempestual Fury
data.description: Tempest's Fury is a wind-element Ninjutsu that summons a devastating storm of immense size and power.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging tempest, its ferocious winds slamming into %target with relentless force.

data.name: Terra Shift
data.description: Shift through the earth with solid force.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user focuses their chakra into the earth beneath their feet. The ground responds, softening momentarily as %user merges with the terrain, disappearing from sight. They move beneath the surface, undetectable and protected by layers of earth and stone. With a sudden burst of energy, %user re-emerges at a new location, the ground parting to allow their passage. As they exit the earth, the displaced soil surges outward, creating a small shockwave that can stagger nearby enemies. The battlefield trembles under their command as %user uses the very ground beneath them as a conduit for swift and tactical repositioning.

data.name: Thunderbolt Fusillade
data.description: Summon a barrage of lightning bolts while surrounding yourself with a current that protects against harmful effects.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless storm of thunderbolts at %target as a protective current surrounds %user, repelling harmful effects.

data.name: Tidal Crash
data.description: Uses water-enhanced strikes to overwhelm the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into the water, amplifying their strength to unleash a series of powerful, wave-infused blows that batter %target, leaving them soaked and disoriented.

data.name: Tidal Shift
data.description: The user transforms into surging water, darting across the battlefield to evade attacks while boosting their offensive power before striking with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user harnesses the power of water, their body becoming fluid and untouchable. In a surge of motion, they dissolve into a torrent that sweeps across the battlefield, dodging attacks as waves crash in their wake. Reforming in an instant, %user channels the gathered momentum into a devastating, water-imbued strike that greatly enhances their offensive power.

data.name: Wind Style: Sky Dragon
data.description: A piercing wind dragon that tears through enemies, inflicting wound damage that continues to bleed over time.
data.battleDescription: A furious gust howls as %user thrusts their palms toward the heavens, molding chakra into a colossal dragon of cutting wind. The creature coils above, its translucent form shimmering like glass before diving with a deafening roar. Its spiraling body tears through the air, slicing everything in its path as it drives straight through %target. The impact leaves deep, invisible wounds that continue to rip and bleed under the lingering force of the gale.

data.name: Abyssal Suffocation
data.description: A drowning illusion that saps the enemy’s vitality and rejuvenates the caster.
data.battleDescription: With a simple seal and a piercing gaze, the user traps %target in a genjutsu where the ocean turns against them. Water crashes down in suffocating waves as spectral tides pull them into an abyss of pressure and despair. As %target gasps for air within the illusion, the user draws strength from their suffering—regaining vitality with every heartbeat stolen beneath the surface.

data.name: Abyssal Surge
data.description: A brutal water-based jutsu that enhances the user’s power while absorbing strength through every strike.
data.battleDescription: %user steadies their breath, water beginning to churn and rise from the ground like a tide answering a silent call. Abyssal Surge engulfs their body in dense, high-pressure chakra drawn from oceanic depths. As the aura wraps tightly around their limbs and core, it sharpens their strikes and hardens their defense. Each enemy blow is dulled, absorbed into the fluid barrier before it reaches flesh. In this state, the user becomes both sharper and harder to strike—a relentless force riding the surge of the abyss.

data.name: Aqua Fang Strike
data.description: A vicious water-infused strike that deals damage and allows the user to absorb incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user darts in low, water forming around their arm in the shape of a serrated fang. With a sharp forward burst, they drive the strike into %target, a spiral of pressurized water lashing outward on impact. As the blow lands, the chakra doesn’t fade—it lingers, swirling around %user in thin, translucent rings. This water actively siphons the force from %target’s future attacks, absorbing a portion of the damage dealt and redirecting it harmlessly into the flowing barrier.

data.name: Aqua Serpent Strike
data.description: A fluid, water-based taijutsu strike that lashes the target and leaves them more susceptible to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra through their limbs, shaping it into a sinuous, whip-like flow around their arm. With swift, coiling motion, they dart toward %target and unleash a fierce, fluid strike that lashes across flesh like a serpent breaking the surface. The impact disorients the enemy’s defenses, soaking them in reactive chakra that lingers like venom—heightening the damage they suffer from subsequent attacks. The strike is silent, swift, and merciless—like the serpent it’s named for.

data.name: Blazing Knuckle
data.description: A fierce fire-infused combo that scorches on impact and leaves the enemy vulnerable to Taijutsu.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists ignite with concentrated fire chakra, the heat pulsing with each movement. They launch into a flurry of blazing punches, hammering %target with rapid, explosive force. Each strike forces fire chakra into the target’s frame, loosening muscle control and distorting their ability to brace. The result is lasting vulnerability—%target becomes far more susceptible to future Taijutsu strikes

data.name: Blazing Reprisal
data.description: A fiery barrier that  swarms the target absorbing there lifeforce while scorching them.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a fiery barrier that absorbs a portion of %target’s health,  while searing them in immense heat

data.name: Bonecrusher Kick
data.description: A brutal close-range kick that weakens the enemy’s overall combat capabilities.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, planting one foot with brutal precision as their leg whips into a wide, crushing arc. The kick slams into %target with raw, unfiltered force—striking deep into the nervous system and chakra flow. The impact causes more than just physical pain; it scrambles coordination, drains resolve, and fogs concentration. Strength and Speed are dulled, while Willpower and Intelligence flicker under the weight of the blow.

data.name: Chakra Enfeeblement
data.description: A precise chakra-infused strike that disrupts the enemy’s defenses and makes them take more damage.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a brief sequence of hand seals, projecting a wave of refined chakra directly into %target’s system. The energy latches onto their internal flow, destabilizing it with precision. Defensive chakra pathways collapse under the interference, causing %target’s body to react poorly to incoming attacks. Their guard weakens, and every hit taken from that point forward lands harder than before.

data.name: Chakra Invigoration
data.description: A quick movement technique that energizes the user and boosts their stats.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a burst of chakra-enhanced motion, leaving afterimages as they reposition across the battlefield. As their body moves, internal chakra flow heightens—enhancing physical and mental performance all at once.

data.name: Chouryū Ken
data.description: A rising water-based taijutsu strike that sends the user soaring skyward.
data.battleDescription: %user crouches low, water coiling around their arm like a living serpent. With a surge of momentum, they launch into a leaping uppercut, water bursting upward in a spiraling torrent. As the punch ascends, it forms the shape of a roaring dragon made entirely of water, propelling %user into the air. The soaked terrain beneath them churns from the pressure, marking the devastating path left behind by the Soaring Dragon Fist.

data.name: Crashing Wave Palm
data.description: A swift, water‑infused palm strike that delivers solid damage and envelops the user in a watery barrier, reducing incoming damage
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra into their palm, forming rippling currents around their arm. With a deep breath, they dash forward, their movements fluid like the ocean. Upon contact, the palm strike releases a compressed burst of water pressure, slamming into %target with crushing force. The strike not only deals direct damage but wraps %user in a protective layer of moving water, softening the blows of subsequent attacks. The battlefield ripples with the aftermath of the blow, as if a wave had passed through.

data.name: Crimson Spires
data.description:
A cursed spike technique that makes the enemy take more damage and suffer recoil when they strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user conjures blood-red chakra spikes beneath %target’s feet. The moment they pierce upward, they embed a lingering curse that tears at the %target’s body whenever they move or attack. All incoming damage becomes harder to withstand, and each strike %target makes sends backlash through their own frame.

data.name: Cyclone
data.description: A violent genjutsu that deals damage and leaves the target wounded
data.battleDescription: %user spins their fingers subtly, releasing a genjutsu that swirls into %target’s mind like a twisting cyclone. Within moments, the enemy is trapped in a howling illusion, disoriented by phantom winds that lash and rip at their senses. The mental strain tears at their resistance, leaving their mind raw and far more susceptible to incoming genjutsu. What began as a single storm becomes a gateway for future torment.

data.name: Delayed Tempest
data.description: A genjutsu that makes the target hear and dread the oncoming storm
data.battleDescription: %user casts an illusion that triggers moments after eye contact, creating a false sense of calm before the storm erupts. When it activates, %target is caught in a delayed mental tempest—violent wind, piercing sounds, and blinding flashes that strike their senses all at once. As the illusion disrupts the battlefield, %user appears to shift positions amidst the chaos, empowered by the storm’s momentum. Their chakra surges, enhancing their offensive strength for the next strike.

data.name: Earth Release: Seven Heavenly Pillars
data.description: Massive stone pillars erupt from the ground, damaging the enemy and weakening their attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, summoning seven towering stone pillars that burst upward beneath %target. The crushing force damages them on impact and leaves them staggered, reducing their ability to strike effectively.

data.name: Electric Prison
data.description: An electrifying genjutsu that deals damage and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra and a flicker of illusion, %user traps %target in a prison of blinding lightning. The phantom bolts lash at their senses, sending jolts of searing pain through their body. Paralyzed and overwhelmed, the target is unable to move as the crackling current locks down both body and mind.

data.name: Endless Drowning
data.description:
A powerful genjutsu that overwhelms the target’s senses with the illusion of being pulled into an infinite, drowning ocean.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and casts a crushing illusion of a boundless, inescapable sea. In an instant, the battlefield melts away as torrents of water rise from nothing, surrounding %target in a vast, cold abyss. The sense of drowning becomes unbearable—sight warps, sounds distort, and movements feel paralyzed under the weight of imagined pressure. Panic and helplessness set in as the illusion traps the target’s mind in an endless descent.

data.name: Eroding Current
data.description: A surging water current that bursts from the ground, damaging the enemy and making them take more damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra into the ground, summoning a sudden upward torrent beneath %target. The relentless pressure of the surge breaks their footing and erodes their guard, amplifying the impact of future attacks.

data.name: Fire Release: Inferno
data.description: A raging sea of flames that overwhelms the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of fire that engulfs %target, consuming them in relentless, burning fury

data.name: Flame Crescent Slash
data.description: A wide and fiery slash that releases a crescent-shaped flame towards the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense fire chakra into their blade and unleashes a wide, flaming arc aimed directly at %target. The searing crescent tears across the battlefield in a blazing trail, striking with devastating force and leaving a charred path in its wake.

data.name: Flame Vortex
data.description: A violent spiral of fire that erupts beneath the enemy and engulfs them in searing destruction.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into the earth, erupting a spinning column of flames beneath %target. The spiraling inferno engulfs them in a brutal surge of heat and force, designed for pure devastation without any lingering effects.

data.name: Gaia's Wrath
data.description: This jutsu enables the user to create a massive hammer made of the elements and smash their opponents with incredible might.
data.battleDescription: %user jumps high into the air and draws a long pole. As %user reaches the peak of their jump they start to channel incredible amounts of earthen chakra into the end of the pole to form a huge hammer of natural elements. Mere moments later, %user comes down with the weight of the earth and devastates %target with massive force.

data.name: Gale Force Blast
data.description: A piercing wind burst that rips through defenses and amplifies ninjutsu vulnerability.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses a violent burst of wind chakra into a narrow stream and launches it toward %target. The blast drills through defenses, disrupting their chakra flow and making them more vulnerable to all incoming ninjutsu techniques.

data.name: Gale Force Kick
data.description: A wind-infused taijutsu kick that strikes with explosive force, sending enemies flying.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their legs, the air around them spiraling into a violent vortex. With a sudden burst of movement, they leap and twist, launching a devastating kick toward %target. The moment of impact unleashes a compressed burst of wind that strikes like a cannon blast—tearing through defenses and hurling the enemy backwards.

data.name: Gale Mirage
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and reflects part of the damage back onto the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a single-handed seal, and the air begins to shimmer with illusory distortions. A cascade of spectral wind blades surrounds %target, slicing into their senses and nerves with phantom pain. As they react, a portion of their own force is turned against them—reflected through the genjutsu’s twisting illusions—causing recoil damage that echoes the pain they inflict.

data.name: Gale Palm Strike
data.description: A swift wind-enhanced strike that boosts the user’s Taijutsu power and closes distance with precision.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, carried by slicing currents of wind chakra. Their body glides low across the battlefield like a stormfront breaking through resistance. With a flash-step and a palm strike infused with sharp, compressed air, they slam into %target with explosive force. As the wind detonates from their strike zone, %user’s chakra flares—amplifying their Taijutsu output in the aftermath.

data.name: Gale Reaver
data.description: A devastating wind strike that tears through the enemy with overwhelming force.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers immense wind chakra into a concentrated edge and releases it in a sweeping arc. The resulting surge carves through the air with violent speed, shredding everything in its path and crashing into %target with brutal precision

data.name: Graveyard of Stone
data.description: An earth-based genjutsu that hits hard, overwhelming the target with visions of their body being buried and crushed alive by jagged stone.
data.battleDescription: The user performs a silent sequence of hand seals before slamming a palm to the ground. In an instant, the terrain warps in the target’s vision as they are plunged into a nightmarish realm of collapsing cliffs and shifting tombs. The enemy sees themselves standing in a vast graveyard where every headstone bears their name. Stone hands erupt from the earth, grabbing at their limbs and dragging them downward as the sky rains jagged obsidian boulders. With each phantom impact, real pain blossoms—blurring the line between illusion and reality. The oppressive weight of stone breaks their focus and crushes their will, delivering devastating damage through sheer psychological terror.

data.name: Infernal Mirage
data.description: Fire genjutsu that deals damage and increases how much genjutsu damage the enemy takes.
data.battleDescription: The user executes a sequence of fluid hand seals, projecting the opponent into an intense illusion of a hellish landscape. The burning terrain pulses with psychological torment, disorienting the target’s perception and leaving them increasingly exposed to future genjutsu. The more they struggle, the deeper the illusion claws into their mind.

data.name: Infernal Surge
data.description: Channeling searing flames, the user ignites their body and strikes, engulfing their foe in fire while fueling their own attacks with unrelenting heat.
data.battleDescription: A roar of flame erupts as %user’s body ignites with blazing energy, surging forward in a torrent of fire. The onslaught engulfs %target, searing through defenses while each ember clings to %user—feeding their power, amplifying the fury behind every strike that follows.

data.name: Inferno Burst
data.description: A focused eruption of flame that burns the enemy and leaves them vulnerable to future ninjutsu attacks
data.battleDescription: %user expels a high-speed blast of condensed fire chakra that detonates on impact with %target, scorching their body and chakra network. The heat lingers, disrupting their chakra defenses and increasing the damage they take from future ninjutsu techniques.

data.name: Inferno Kick
data.description: A flame-infused kick that burns on impact and continues searing over time
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, the limb igniting in a blaze that roars with each step. With a swift leap and a violent spin, they deliver a flaming kick to %target, the impact erupting in a burst of searing heat. The flames cling to the point of contact, continuing to burn and inflict damage over time.

data.name: Inferno Kunai Barrage
data.description: Throw a rapid-fire barrage of flaming kunai that damages the target and leaves them burning.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless stream of flaming kunai at %target, each one carving through the air with searing heat. The scorching impacts ignite lingering flames that continue to burn %target.

data.name: Lightning Flash Strike
data.description: A devastating lightning-charged slash that inflicts heavy damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels raw lightning into their blade and launches at %target in a blinding flash. The strike cleaves through the air with violent speed, erupting in an electric burst upon contact. The sheer velocity and power tear through defenses, leaving behind scorched ground and stunned silence as arcs of electricity dance across the impact zone.

data.name: Lightning Release: Charged Senbon
data.description: The user throws senbon needles infused with lightning chakra, which can pierce through defenses and deliver a paralyzing shock to the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a cluster of senbon needles, each one crackling with electric intensity. With a swift motion, they hurl the needles toward %target. As the senbon strike, a burst of lightning erupts on contact, disrupting motor control and delivering a jolt that leaves %target paralyzed. The precision and speed of the assault make recovery nearly impossible in the moment.

data.name: Limit Breaker
data.description: A taijutsu stance that surges the user’s power while suppressing the enemy’s ability to strike back.
data.battleDescription: %user tightens their stance, breathing slow and deep as raw fighting spirit surges through their limbs. Muscles tense. Focus sharpens. Taijutsu power spikes violently—strikes hit harder, movements become instinctive. At the same time, the user’s aura emits crushing pressure that destabilizes %target’s combat rhythm, weakening their offensive output.

data.name: Majestic Flame
data.description: A spiraling blaze of fire chakra that damages the enemy and leaves them burning.
data.battleDescription: %user channels refined fire chakra into a spiraling blaze that engulfs %target. The scorching flames deal damage and continue to burn after the initial impact.

data.name: Mental Fortress
data.description: Boosts the user’s damage while weakening the enemy’s offensive strength.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a firm seal, eyes locked with unshakable focus. A web of radiant chakra sigils ignites from their body, expanding outward in layered rings that pulse with calculated force. The mental barrier they project doesn’t block attacks physically—it disrupts the intent behind them, unraveling the precision of enemy strikes. As the battlefield warps subtly under this pressure, %user’s resolve sharpens, amplifying their own power while clouding the enemy’s offensive edge.

data.name: Midare
data.description: A relentless barrage that deals damage and allows the user to absorb incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls forward into a whirlwind of motion, striking %target with a rapid barrage of kunai infused with water chakra. Each slash and throw disrupts the opponent's rhythm while thin currents of chakra swirl around %user’s body. With every movement, the surrounding moisture condenses into a protective flow, allowing them to absorb some of the damage from incoming attacks.

data.name: Mizukumi
data.description: A water-based jutsu that strikes hard and surrounds you with a veil that absorbs incoming damage to restore your health.
data.battleDescription: %user moves like liquid vengeance—fluid, controlled, and deadly. As they strike %target, water chakra lashes out with every movement. After the impact, the water wraps around %user like a protective veil, absorbing incoming force and restoring their health.

data.name: Mizushibari
data.description: A water-based strike that crushes the enemy and siphons incoming damage away from the user.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a burst of high-pressure water that lashes out toward %target, striking with force before swirling around their own body. The lingering vortex hardens like fluid armor, absorbing a portion of the damage from enemy attacks that follow.

data.name: Mountain Crusher
data.description: A devastating earth-powered strike that reduces the enemy’s ability to deal damage
data.battleDescription: Description: %user drives forward with immovable force, earth chakra wrapping around their limb like the weight of a mountain. The strike lands against %target with crushing density, sending a seismic jolt through their frame.

data.name: Phantom Gale
data.description: A powerful genjutsu that unleashes an ethereal wind assault, dealing heavy damage and overwhelming the target's senses.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into the air, weaving an illusion that bends wind into spectral blades. As the winds roar and converge around %target, their vision fractures—phantoms of slicing gales lashing from every direction. The illusion feels real, striking with such precision and force that even the ground trembles underfoot. Each gust tears into the senses, making escape feel impossible as %target is enveloped by a tempest of illusory devastation.

data.name: Phantom Whirlpool
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and boosts the user's genjutsu damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the illusion of a massive whirlpool swirling beneath %target’s feet, dragging their senses into a spiraling abyss. As the illusion tightens, the crushing pressure distorts their perception, causing real damage and mentally fracturing their defenses. The user’s mastery over the genjutsu deepens with the cast, heightening the force behind future illusions.

data.name: Phoenix Heart
data.description: A fierce illusion ignites the battlefield, weakening the enemy’s mind while amplifying the caster’s genjutsu power.
data.battleDescription: The user’s chakra flares with ethereal fire as they weave hand signs that blur the line between reality and illusion. %target finds themselves engulfed in a rising inferno of rebirth, their thoughts seared by the haunting cries of a celestial phoenix. As their mental defenses crumble, the user’s own genjutsu prowess surges, emboldened by the ashes of the enemy’s weakening will.

data.name: Phoenix's Wrath Strike
data.description: A devastating fire-enhanced taijutsu that weakens the enemy’s physical prowess while amplifying the user’s own power.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra through their limbs, the aura shimmering like molten wings poised to strike. With a fierce step forward, they deliver a crushing blow that erupts on contact with %target, igniting not only flesh but the very force behind their movements. Flames snake through %target’s muscles, disrupting their physical strength, slowing their reflexes, and softening their taijutsu guard. As the embers cling to %user, their own strikes begin to blaze hotter and hit harder.

data.name: Quaking Fist
data.description: A crushing earth-infused strike that damages and disrupts the enemy’s mental and spiritual strength.
data.battleDescription: %user anchors their stance, fists brimming with stone-cracking force. With a forward stomp and a devastating punch, they channel tectonic weight into %target’s body—blow landing like the fall of a mountain. But the damage isn’t just physical. The shock seeps inward, fracturing focus, disrupting chakra flow, and shaking the very core of %target’s will. Their Ninjutsu and Genjutsu control falter, intelligence dims under pressure, and willpower erodes like stone in a quake

data.name: Quicksand Trap
data.description: The illusion drowns the enemy in endless sands, weakening their assault and dulling their senses.
data.battleDescription: The user calmly weaves a deceptive genjutsu, casting the illusion of the ground collapsing beneath the enemy into a churning pit of quicksand. Within the mirage, the sands twist and coil, dragging the target downward as invisible pressure grinds at their body and mind. Their perception of movement slows, their senses dulled by the crushing despair. Meanwhile, the user gains a protective clarity, their awareness sharpened against oncoming attacks. The result is a mirage that defends the caster while eroding the will and health of the target.

data.name: Rai Yari
data.description: A lightning spear that strikes with force and charges the user’s chakra for greater power.
data.battleDescription: %user’s chakra erupts in a crackle of lightning as they form a spear of raw energy in one hand. With a fierce cry, they hurl it forward—lightning tearing through the air in a blinding streak. The spear slams toward %target with explosive force, surging back into the user’s core and igniting their chakra into an overcharged state, heightening the destructive potential of every jutsu that follows.
